interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Wayfinding and Signage
interventions.description: Provide clear directional signage to help pedestrians navigate the isolated corridor and find nearby exits or destinations.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the width of the pedestrian walkway to provide a safer and more comfortable environment that meets accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Grade-Separated Crossing
interventions.description: Install a pedestrian bridge to allow safe passage over the high-speed roadway if pedestrian demand is present.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and shorten potential crossing distances.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Markings
interventions.description: Apply paint to define travel lanes and narrow them to naturally slow traffic speeds and organize vehicle flow.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to safely break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Complete Street Redesign
interventions.description: If this is an urban arterial, the roadway requires a total redesign to include protected sidewalks and safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Grade-Separated Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Given the heavy infrastructure and likely high speeds, a pedestrian bridge or underpass may be necessary to provide connectivity between the separated urban areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a physical buffer, such as planters or a protected bike lane, between the sidewalk and the high-speed travel lanes.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: If this is a frequent pedestrian route, install a signalized mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings to provide a safe way to cross the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to ensure pedestrian connectivity and safety on both sides.

interventions.title: Install Protected Pedestrian Walkway
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk or multi-use path separated from vehicle traffic by a crash-rated barrier to provide safe passage.

interventions.title: Install sidewalk on left side
interventions.description: Provide a continuous paved walkway on the left side of the street to ensure pedestrian connectivity.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Installing a median refuge island would break up the crossing distance and provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage would provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Separated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: If pedestrian connectivity is required across this corridor, a fully grade-separated or physically protected walkway must be constructed.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Scale Lighting
interventions.description: If a walkway is provided, adequate lighting is necessary for safety and security in this isolated environment.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install a physically separated bike lane to provide a buffer between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve safety.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.
